tool.name: tidk_explore
tool.description: `tidk explore` attempts to find the simple telomeric repeat unit in the genome provided. It will report this repeat in its canonical form (e.g. TTAGG -> AACCT).

param.name: threads
param.label: Number of Threads
param.help: Number of CPU threads to use

tool.help:
**tidk_explore**
`tidk explore` attempts to find the simple telomeric repeat unit in the genome provided. It will report this repeat in its canonical form (e.g. TTAGG -> AACCT).
**nf-core Module Information:**
- Module: tidk/explore - Container: biocontainers/tidk:0.2.41--hdbdd923_0
**Usage:** This tool provides the functionality from the nf-core module within Galaxy workflows.
